summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing it completed the previously announced sale of its roughly 64% ownership stake in Chilean water utility Suralis S.A. to a fund managed by Toesca S.A. Administradora General de Fondos. Total proceeds were approximately $126.4 million plus an earnout of up to $1.5 million; the deal was first announced August 28, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Proceeds are earmarked for debt paydown and capital recycling into the 2026-2028 capital plan; this is a completed divestiture supporting portfolio simplification, so the arbitrage angle is minimal post-close.
